decisions.reason: As a digital workflow extension tightly related to the firm’s dental practice software, this app fits its existing knowledge base and R&D capabilities, so management is likely to retain and improve it rather than withdraw it.

Although somewhat less core than software, the education institute builds on the firm’s customer relationships, training resources, and practitioner knowledge, making continuation more likely than exit.
A remote support tool directly complements the firm’s established support and software services, and with strong absorptive capacity in its domain the firm is likely to keep it on the market.
